approved_scope.title: Chough init sets up SpecSync for a new project: init, scaffold, check and adopt (DRIVE-23, slice 6)
approved_scope.description: chough init sets up SpecSync for a new project: init, scaffold, check and adopt (DRIVE-23, slice 6)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-cli-062 (new): chough init with at least one --module, in a project with neither .specsync/ nor specs/, runs specsync init, scaffold per module, check and change adopt before its own writes, reporting each under specsync_setup; otherwise it runs none and says why; a failed step or a missing specsync refuses with nothing of Chough's written, naming the steps left (or the install command) and the same chough init, which a test runs. The walkthrough's new-project section uses chough init --module. Five tests in tests/setup.rs fail first, each mutant in testing.md fails one, and fledge run linux-verify passes.

answers.constraints: DRIVE-23 (captured from Leif's 'Capture + build', relayed by the orc 2026-11-07), slice 6 of Chough drives SpecSync; DRIVE-20. A new project means a named module and neither .specsync/ nor specs/, so fixtures and existing projects keep today's init. Order probed with SpecSync 6.2.0 in a scratch project. REQ-cli-062 (061 is #188's). Rule: a refusal names a recovery and a test runs it. Lesson: list new source files in the owning spec after approval, and run the spec coverage check locally before Linux verify.
